newsitem.title: THAILAND: Errant scalpel may have killed Thai man.
newsitem.headline: Errant scalpel may have killed Thai man.

text.p: From his ashes, it seems a forgotten scalpel may have been the death of Prachuab Kangae.
While collecting Prachuab's bones on Thursday after his body was cremated, grieving relatives were baffled to find a four-inch scalpel -- four months after he had surgery.

Prachuab's younger brother Somporn Kangae, the village head in Palien about 900 km (540 miles) south of Bangkok, told reporters the family believed the scalpel was left inside Prachuab's body when he had kidney surgery in November.
Two months after his operation Prachuab was readmitted to hospital complaining of continued pain. He was given painkillers and released from hospital.
"He was complaining about the pain from where he received surgery until he died and we believe that the scalpel left in his body was the real cause of his death," Somporn said.
Somporn said his family was considering legal action against the hospital.
